Messages.Author: Mikko Saari
Messages.Body:
Does the vampire I attack with Hidden Lurker need to have blocked m y
vampire? If I attack him first with Bum's Rush and my opponent does
not block, can I follow it up with Hidden Lurker? It does say, after
all, "blocking minion"...

--

msaari
@jyu.fi

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The action must have been blocked to have one of your vampires play
Hidden Lurker - if there's no block, then there's no blocking minion.

--
